challenges.name: linq-deferred-execution-quiz
challenges.title: Predict it: when does a LINQ query run?
challenges.description: Run a deferred query in your head after its inputs change, then decide which LINQ statements behave the way their authors expected.

questions.explanation: Where does not run when the query is defined: late only stores the source list and the lambda. string.Join enumerates it at the last line, and at that moment the lambda reads the CURRENT value of the captured variable grace (7) and walks the CURRENT list (2, 8, 6, 10). 8 > 7 and 10 > 7, so it prints "8,10". "8,6" is what you would get by calling ToList() right after Where, when grace was still 5 and 10 was not in the list. "8,6,10" mixes the old grace with the new list, and "8" the new grace with the old list.

questions.question: Which of these statements are true? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: scores.Where(s => s > 8).Count() and scores.Count(s => s > 8) count the same elements; the second is just shorter. ToList() enumerates the query at once and copies the results into a new list, which later changes to the source do not affect. Average() on an empty sequence of double throws InvalidOperationException "Sequence contains no elements" (Sum() returns 0, Average() has no value to return). FirstOrDefault() on an empty List<string> returns default(string), which is null. ids.Select(id => Send(id)) sends nothing at that line: Select is deferred, so Send runs only when something enumerates the query, and once more on every further enumeration. Single(predicate) throws InvalidOperationException "Sequence contains more than one matching element" when several elements match; it never picks one.

options.text: scores.Where(s => s > 8).Count() and scores.Count(s => s > 8) return the same number
After var list = query.ToList(), adding items to the query's source list does not change list
var sent = ids.Select(id => Send(id)); sends every SMS exactly once, at this line
Single(predicate) returns the first match when several elements match

challenges.name: fix-late-fee-reminder-job
challenges.title: Fix the late-fee job that queues every reminder twice
challenges.description: Every morning at 06:00, Sen Academy's late-fee job sends one reminder per overdue invoice: one outbox row and one SMS to the parents, with a shorter grace period in the first month of term. The accountant finds the same student two or three times in the outbox with different ids, and the log announces fewer reminders than the SMS that go out. Fix RunReminderJob so that every overdue invoice gets exactly one outbox row, the first-month rule is applied, and both log lines describe the reminders that were really sent. The test runner reads the settings and the invoices, runs the job and prints the outbox.

grace 5
first-month no
HS-1024 1800000 4 unpaid
HS-1025 1800000 12 unpaid

[sms] #501 to the parents of HS-1025: late fee 36000 VND
